description:
The plot illustrates the average repetition rate of words across different relation categories, comparing several conditions related to data processing and model training. The x-axis, labeled “Relation Category,” is linear, ranging from 0 to 60, with tick marks at integer values. The y-axis, labeled “Average Repetition Rate,” is linear, ranging from 0 to 0.6, with tick marks at 0.1 intervals. 

The line labeled “w/o DPO obo” is blue, lacks markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately 0.227 at x=0, fluctuates between approximately 0.117 to 0.3, reaching a peak of approximately 0.5 at x=2, then generally declines to approximately 0.163 at x=60. The line labeled “w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” is orange, lacks markers, and is solid; it starts at approximately 0.163 at x=0, and increases to approximately 0.4 at x=18, subsequently decreasing and remaining around 0.163 at x=60. The line labeled “DPO” is green, lacks markers, and is solid; it begins at approximately 0.117 at x=0 and fluctuates within a narrow range between approximately 0.08 to 0.16 until x=50, then increases to approximately 0.227 at x=60. The line labeled “Average of w/o DPO obo” is light blue, lacks markers, and is dashed; it begins at approximately 0.163 at x=0 and fluctuates between approximately 0.117 to 0.3, with various peaks and declines. The line labeled “Average of w/o DPO obo & w/o div-hint” is light orange, lacks markers, and is dashed; it  starts at approximately 0.117 at x=0 and fluctuates between approximately 0.117 to 0.35. The line labeled “Average of DPO” is light green, lacks markers, and is dashed; it begins at approximately 0.08 at x=0 and fluctuates around 0.15 before ending at approximately 0.16 at x=60.
